steps: Collect herbs for treatment — collect herbs from the supplies, defeat Drakan Patrol Scout, defeat Drakan Patrol Supporter (Kibelisk: Amunta's Hideout)
Treat the Fallen Daybreak Society Members — administer herbal medicine to the first member, administer herbal medicine to the second member (Kibelisk: Amunta's Hideout)

Collect materials to repair Zemurru's Totem — search the Pile of Broken Totems, collect materials from Drakan Patrol Totem, retrieve the Drakan Patrol Sorcery Talisman, defeat Drakan Patrol Totem (Kibelisk: Eastern Gribade Highland Cliff)
Deliver totem restoration materials to Amunta — talk to Amunta (Kibelisk: Amunta's Hideout)
Go to the Steel Hammer Temporary Trading Post — meet with Amunta (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Temporary Trading Post)
Find materials necessary for infiltration — gather materials from the Shulak Cart (Kibelisk: Steel Hammer Temporary Trading Post)
